item.title: Paragon Planners: PART-TIME Remote Administrative Scheduler
item.description:
Headquarters: Oregon
URL: https://paragonplanners.com/employment/

PART-TIME Remote Administrative Scheduler | 20–30 Hours/Week

100% Remote | Monday–Friday | $18.50–$20.00/hour, based on experience

Paragon Planners is looking for a professional, dependable, and highly organized Administrative Scheduler to join our remote team.

In this role, you’ll support professionals in the financial services industry by managing schedules, connecting with clients, and helping keep their day-to-day operations organized and running smoothly.

This position offers 20–30 hours per week, with work taking place during regular Monday - Friday business hours. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, takes pride in staying organized, and is looking for meaningful professional work without a traditional 40-hour schedule.

What You’ll Do

As an Administrative Scheduler, you’ll build relationships with the professionals you support while helping them stay connected with their clients.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Making outbound calls to schedule and confirm appointments

  • Communicating professionally with clients by phone and email

  • Managing calendars and coordinating schedules

  • Entering and maintaining accurate information in client databases

  • Following established processes and client-specific instructions

  • Providing dependable administrative support throughout the workweek

This role is a good fit for someone who is personable, comfortable on the phone, detail-oriented, and enjoys being the person who keeps things organized behind the scenes.

Schedule & Availability

Because our Administrative Schedulers support clients throughout the business day, consistent Monday–Friday availability is required.

  • Availability is needed during standard business hours, generally 8:30 AM–5:00 PM in the client’s time zone

  • Both morning and afternoon availability are required throughout the week

  • Working hours may not fall into one continuous block each day

  • Schedules are based on the needs of the clients you support

  • Initial hours may build gradually as you complete onboarding and are assigned to clients

This position is designed for candidates specifically seeking part-time work. If you are seeking a traditional 40-hour workweek or full-time employment, this position will not be the right fit.

Training & Onboarding

We provide training and support to help new employees learn our systems, processes, and the expectations of the role.

New employees should plan for approximately 8–12 hours of training per week during the initial training period. As you progress through onboarding, you may begin working with clients while continuing to complete your training.

Client assignments are based on current business needs and finding the right match between employees and the professionals they support, so candidates should be comfortable with a gradual ramp-up in hours.

What We’re Looking For

Successful candidates are typically:

  • Warm, polished, and professional communicators

  • Comfortable speaking with clients by phone

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented

  • Dependable and responsive

  • Able to work independently and manage their time effectively

  • Comfortable following detailed instructions and adapting to different client preferences

  • Comfortable learning new technology

  • Experienced in administrative support, scheduling, customer service, or another client-facing role

  • Interested in a long-term professional opportunity

Previous remote-work experience is helpful, but not required.

Location Requirements

We are currently only hiring in the following states: AL, AZ, FL, GA, ID, KY, LA, MI, MO, NC, OH, OR, SC, TN, TX, UT & WY.

Applicants must reside in one of the states listed above to be considered.

We do not hire outside of the United States.

Home Office & Technology Requirements

Because this is a fully remote position, employees must have:

  • A quiet, professional home-office environment suitable for client calls

  • Reliable high-speed internet

  • A Windows 11 computer

  • The ability to participate in video meetings and training

Macs, iPads, Chromebooks, and virtual machines are not compatible with the technology requirements of this position.

Background Screening

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of required background screening. Due to the nature of our work within the financial services industry, our screening process is comprehensive and may include multiple background checks.

Compensation

Starting pay: $18.50–$20.00 per hour, based on relevant experience.

Employees are eligible for a compensation review after six months, with opportunities for continued increases as they gain experience and tenure with Paragon Planners.

About Paragon Planners

Paragon Planners provides administrative and scheduling support to professionals in the financial services industry. Our remote team helps clients manage their schedules, stay connected with their customers, and keep important day-to-day details moving.

We value professionalism, dependability, strong communication, and people who genuinely enjoy helping others.

Ready to Apply?

If you enjoy working with people, love keeping things organized, and are looking for a professional remote role with weekday hours, we’d love to hear from you.

Please follow all application instructions carefully. Incomplete or incorrectly submitted applications will not be considered.

Paragon Planners is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/paragon-planners-part-time-remote-administrative-scheduler

item.title: Pinterest: Finance Manager I, Platform
item.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

As a Financial Manager focused onTechnology Infrastructure, you will have financial and strategic oversight for managing and optimizing the significant investments Pinterest makes in its technology infrastructure (primarily AWS, our cloud-based computational and storage provider). This is a critical role that sits at the center of how Pinterest executes its technology and innovation strategy. You will play a key role - in partnership with technology infrastructure leadership - in governing our infrastructure investments, managing key vendor relationships (especially AWS) and ensuring we can cost effectively serve Pinners and Advertisers while also enabling future technological innovation … while also being able to allocate and track costs at the appropriate level within the company. These teams and technology service providers are the foundation of our online service as well as how our Engineering, Product and Design teams execute their work.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure and Technical Program Management teams to develop annual, monthly, and weekly operational investments and related infrastructure demand and financial forecasts
  • Compile monthly, quarterly, and annual variance analysis
  • Identify and drive initiatives to continuously improve, automate, and grow OPEX and infrastructure forecasting, and reporting tools and processes
  • Champion and AI-First approach to Technology finance partnership — embedding AI tools into forecasting, metrics analysis, and finance decision-making to raise the bar for how Finance drives impact
  • Design usage prediction models for short and long-term resource capacity needs
  • Proactively identify risks and opportunities
  • Perform strategic, time-sensitive analysis and communicate key takeaways

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Experience with forecasting expenses, with a strong preference for prior experience managing technology infrastructure spending on public infrastructure cloud platforms and product offerings 
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate financial analysis and forecasting workflows, with a rigorous approach to validating outputs and maintaining critical ownership of final recommendations 
  • Experience in managing multiple work-streams end-to-end along with working across multiple functions and teams
  • Expertise in building high-level and detailed financial models
  • Strong business partnership skills and verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to multi-task and deliver against timelines
  • Entrepreneurial, flexible, and collaborative mindset
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Accounting or Finance and a minimum of 5 years of Finance or Business Operational experience in a fast-paced industry

 

Relocation Statement:

  •  This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.



In-Office Requirement Statement: 

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6-months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. 

#LI-REMOTE 

#LI-AAR

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

US based applicants only
$98,561—$202,918 USD

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.
 
By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pinterest-finance-manager-i-platform

item.title: Gong.io: IX Enterprise Revenue Architect - Financial Services
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

Enterprise Revenue Architects at Gong are strategic partners to our largest customers. Focused on driving revenue transformation from Gong’s AI Operating System, you’ll guide Financial Services executive stakeholders and operational teams to drive revenue by architecting industry-specific workflows, accelerating adoption, and realizing business results across the entire Financial Services revenue lifecycle.

You will combine a deep understanding of how FinServ revenue teams operate with leading change management strategy to help customers operationalize the use of Gong into tangible business results. Your success is measured by activation and adoption, key persona engagement, customer value realization, and revenue impact (retention and expansion) within the FinServ sector.

This particular role will join our new Industry Expansion (IX) team, focused specifically on customers in the Financial Services industry. You will be joining a "startup within a startup," helping to build the IX outcomes realization journey, leveraging automation, AI, content, and self-service strategies to improve customer health, reduce churn, and increase NDR (Net Dollar Retention) for this critical new segment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Revenue Transformation Strategy: Partner with senior GTM leaders in the FinServ space to design and execute strategies that modernize their revenue operations through Gong’s AIOS.
  • Workflow Architecture: Map current-state FinServ customer processes to AI-driven workflows that translate to revenue outcomes.
  • Adoption and Change Management: Execute adoption initiatives that drive behavior change and embed Gong into daily team rhythms.
  • Value Realization: Use data-driven insights to quantify measurable business outcomes that demonstrate Gong’s ROI and strategic value
  • Renewal and Expansion Management: Own the renewal strategy and execution, partnering with cross-functional teams on growth
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal teams to ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the entire customer journey
QUALIFICATIONS 
  • 10+ years proven experience in managing complex enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders 
  • Experience working with FinServ customers, or working in the FinServ industry
  • Track record of owning relationships with senior (VP and C-suite) stakeholders and owning value and ROI conversations
  • Passion for driving customer centricity by leveraging internal stakeholders such as Sales, Product, Support, Marketing and executives
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Data-driven mindset with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Passion for driving customer outcomes and contributing to a high performing and accountable work culture
  • Our RAs are self-starters who excel in high paced environments and thrive in change and ambiguity. Our top performers have a growth mindset and pride themselves in being coachable. We are a team that values collaboration and winning together, enjoying the ride, and challenging conventional wisdom. If that’s you too, we want to hear from you!
PERKS & BENEFITS 
  • We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs.
  • Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.
  • Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.
  • 401(k) program to help you invest in your future.
  • Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development.
  • Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend.
  • Paid parental leave to support you and your family.
  • Company-wide recharge days each quarter.
  • Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment.

The annual salary hiring range for this position is $89,600- $129,500 USD + 30% variable commission based on performance. 

Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets. 

We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored.

Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

To review Gong's privacy policy, visit https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/ for more details.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gong-io-ix-enterprise-revenue-architect-financial-services
